claim: The proposed eval model groups cases into named, product oriented scenarios.
Nondeterministic behavior is evaluated with expected rates and aggregate named metrics rather than one Boolean result.
Test cases may be loaded dynamically from SQLite, JSON, Postgres, or another store.
The proposed criteria include scenario groups, aggregate metrics, and data loaded from production derived datasets.
The speakers distinguish testing in production from testing locally with production data.
The design process keeps model suggestions provisional because models tend to accept the premise in a user instruction.
note: Time span is broad because the discussion develops across the live design session.
